title: Equipment loan list search
goal: combines labeled search boxes, list styles and input events to display search results and quantities in real time.
summary: Before borrowing a device, students can search it using name fragments. Clearing the search box should return you to the full list.
tasks: Write "device name" as label in index.html, and use for to associate #equipment-query.
Make #equipment-results use a grid in style.css, setting an 8px gap between adjacent devices.
Read keywords in the input event of script.js, remove leading and trailing spaces, ignore English case, and filter out devices whose names contain keywords.
Pass the filtered array to renderDevices. Show “N devices found” with the number of matches. When there are none, display the empty-state message. Clearing the search restores the full list.

example.note: When searching for course titles, convert keywords and text to be matched into lowercase. includes can find a fragment anywhere in the title.

hint: startsWith can only match the beginning, "voice" in the middle of "digital voice recorder". Use includes after converting the device name and keywords to the same case.
